title: Symbols aboard the craft and the gray alliance of seven species

tellings.quote: And um I'm led to believe that um the three um orange circles arranged in an equilateral triangle is the symbol of the gray alliance.

plain: Aboard a craft over Fillmore, California, there were symbols, and three orange circles set in an equilateral triangle stand for the "gray alliance", a grouping of seven species of the small grey-skinned beings of UFO lore. This comes from Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people, who says he was there, and who adds that he was "led to believe" what the symbol means.
